newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy April/May sulphur fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy April/May sulphur fuel oil.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy up to three 38,000-tonne cargoes of low sulphur low pour fuel oil for April and May delivery, a company official said on Thursday.

CPC seeks to buy 1-2 cargoes of 0.5 percent low sulphur fuel oil for delivery April 16-30 and one cargo of 1.0 percent low sulphure fuel oil for delivery May 6-25 to Keelung, Kaohsiung or Shenao, the official said.
The tender closes on March 12 and is valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC bought more than one cargo of 38,000-tonne 0.5 percent low sulphur fuel oil at $136-$139 per tonne.
